title: Folsom Prison Blues
syncedLyrics:
[00:06.12] I hear the train a comin', it's rolling round the bend
[00:11.02] And I ain't seen the sunshine since I don't know when
[00:15.84] I'm stuck in Folsom prison, and time keeps draggin' on
[00:24.98] But that train keeps a rollin' on down to San Antone
[00:32.64] When I was just a baby, my mama told me "son"
[00:37.68] "Always be a good boy, don't ever play with guns"
[00:42.04] But I shot a man in Reno just to watch him die
[00:51.44] When I hear that whistle blowin', I hang my head and cry
[00:59.37] 
[01:24.29] I bet there's rich folks eating in a fancy dining car
[01:29.09] They're probably drinkin' coffee and smoking big cigars
[01:33.35] Well I know I had it coming, I know I can't be free
[01:42.64] But those people keep on movin'
[01:45.81] And that's what tortures me
[01:50.30] 
[02:15.03] Well if they freed me from this prison
[02:17.67] If that railroad train was mine
[02:20.25] I bet I'd move it on a little farther down the line
[02:25.25] Far from Folsom prison, that's where I want to stay
[02:33.80] And I'd let that lonesome whistle blow my blues away
[02:39.59]
